newsitem.title: USA: PMT Services merges with IMA Payment.
newsitem.headline: PMT Services merges with IMA Payment.

text.p: PMT Services Inc said Friday it had merged with IMA Payment Systems Inc in a stock deal.
PMT said it will account the merger as a pooling of interests. It did not reveal the deal's terms.
It said the merger will increase its merchant portfolio by about 2,000 accounts, which have produced an annual charge volume of about $300 million.
It also said it was holding talks with other "potential merger or acquisition candidates."

"During fiscal 1997, PMT has specifically targeted (independent service organizations)," it said. "With one-third of the fiscal year remaining, we have now completed or announced 10 mergers or acquisitions for an aggregate 38,500 accounts."
PMT is an independent service organization, which markets and services electronic credit card authorization and payment systems to small retail and professional businesses.
IMA is also an independent service organization, based in Nashville, Tenn.
